input.command: cd D:\pal; echo "== TALLY COMPANIES =="; try { $tc = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1/tally/companies' -TimeoutSec 30; "count=$(@($tc).Count)"; @($tc) | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { "  - $($_ | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)" } } catch { $r=$_.Exception.Response; if($r){$sr=New-Object IO.StreamReader($r.GetResponseStream()); "HTTP $([int]$r.StatusCode) $($sr.ReadToEnd())"} else {"ERR $($_.Exception.Message)"} }
